type: AI SaaS for architects — CONCEPT-DRIVEN ('architect's desk'), illustration is custom but structure transferable
concept: Architect's desk: beige graph-paper background with 1px grid, 2-colour illustration (blue #1544C8 + beige #D9CDB3 with grain), hand-written annotations, mono UI type, cursor coordinates X/Y in the corner, '①' numbered feature labels

fonts.annotations: handwritten/marker style small caps with underline strokes

moves: hero: huge headline centered with hand-drawn annotations ('ARCHITECTURAL', '→ NOT SOFTWARE') and a framed illustration below with a caption bottom-right
PINNED illustration that the camera dollies/zooms INTO as you scroll (3 keyframes: room → desk → drawing) — one asset, scroll-driven depth
feature panels slide in from the left over the pinned image: '① INTENTS, TRANSLATED!' label, 2-line title, 1 sentence, icon button 'Watch the demo', ghost link 'Explore features'
outlined (stroke-only) giant text as section marker ('Augmented')
mobile: same assets, panel stacks under the framed illustration, nav becomes logo | CTA | Menu
rules_derived: choose a WORLD and give the UI props from it (graph paper, coordinates, marker annotations)
2-colour illustration + grain reads as premium and is cheap to generate consistently
one pinned hero asset with scroll zoom replaces 5 feature screenshots
handwritten annotations = human warmth on a tech product
